Packing List for Hawaii Vacation (June 10th - June 20th, 2024)

Essentials:
- Swimwear (2 sets)
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Beach towel
- Hiking gear (daypack, water bottle, trail shoes)
- Casual outfits (lightweight clothing for beach/activities)
- Formal attire (Luau night)
- Camera with extra batteries
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, insurance)

Activity-specific items:
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Hiking boots (Diamond Head hike)
- Comfortable shoes (North Shore road trip)
- Beach umbrella/umbrella stand
- Waterproof phone case

Other:
- Travel adapter (for electronics)
- Cash and credit cards
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Snacks for beach days
- Reusable water bottle
- Daypack for activities
- Carry-on bag for departure

Notes: Include a journal for travel journaling and a portable charger for devices.
